headline: Approved special permit for CAVA Group LLC; tabled Felton Street and Williams Street zoning and permit requests.
summary: Approved a special permit for CAVA Group LLC. Tabled a zoning amendment at 181-185 Felton Street, a special permit modification at 20 Williams Street, a health insurance resolution, a leaf blowing ordinance amendment, and a snow removal on sidewalks ordinance amendment. Asked the Law Department to review the Felton Street and Williams Street petitions.
decisions: Tabled the zoning ordinance amendment at 181-185 Felton Street by voice vote, after a request for Law Department review was approved.
Tabled the special permit modification at 20 Williams Street by voice vote, after a request for Law Department review was approved.
Approved a request for the Law Department to initiate and draft a home rule petition on health insurance, including the mayor and the city council, by voice vote.
Tabled the health insurance resolution by voice vote.
Approved the special permit for CAVA Group LLC by voice vote, with a revised condition on delivery and dumpster areas.
Approved the suggestion that a Councillor meet with department heads on how the leaf blowing ordinance would be enforced, by voice vote.
Tabled the leaf blowing Chapter 17 ordinance amendment by voice vote.
Approved a request for the Law Department, mayor and DPW Director to attend the next meeting, then tabled the snow removal on sidewalks ordinance amendment by voice vote.

plain_text:
Ordinances & Rules Committee
Meeting Minutes
October 5, 2026
The Chair called the meeting to order at 9:06 p.m.
Present: Councillors Harris, Logan, Hanley & McLaughlin.
Absent: Dunn.
Councillor McLaughlin moved approval of the minutes from 9/21/2026. The motion was 
approved by a voice vote.
Artie Kronefeld, of The Waltham Times, was audio recording the meeting.
First agenda item: Zoning Ordinance Amendment at 181-185 Felton Street
Attorney Mike Connors, representing the petitioner, spoke on the zoning map change. President 
Logan made a request that was approved by a voice vote to have the Law Department review this 
petition. President Logan moved to table the matter. The motion was approved by a voice vote.
Second agenda item: Special Permit modification at 20 Williams Street
Attorney Joseph Connors and petitioner Robert Kaitz spoke on the modification. President Logan 
made a request that was approved by a voice vote to have the Law Department review this 
petition. President Logan moved to table the modification. The motion was approved by a voice 
vote. 
Third agenda item: Health Insurance Resolution
President Logan spoke and made a request that was approved by a voice vote to have the Law 
Department initiate & draft a home rule petition and to include the mayor and the city council. 
The motion was approved by a voice vote. Councillor Hanley asked if the school committee 
should be included.  The original review from the Law Department from 2008 stated they should 
not. President Logan moved to table the matter. The motion was approved by a voice vote.
Councillor Hanley moved to take the CAVA Group LLC special permit application off the table. 
Attorney Michael Connors was present and spoke on his latest revised filing. There is only a 
change to one condition related to map C101. Nick Skoly of VHP was also present and pointed 
out the delivery/dumpster areas on the map. Attorney Connors read the new language into the 
record about delivery and dumpster areas. Councillor Hanley moved approval of the special 
permit. The motion was approved by a voice vote.
President Logan moved to take the leaf blowing Chapter 17 ordinance amendment matter off the 
table.  The motion was approved by a voice vote. Councillor Logan suggested he be the 
spokesperson from the Committee to represent the council to speak to department heads within 
the Law Departments opinion, Solicitor Laughman suggested there be Councillor that meets with 
department heads to discuss in more detail how the ordinance shall be enforced. The motion was 
approved by a voice vote. President Logan moved to table the matter. The motion was approved 
by a voice vote.
President Logan moved to take the snow removal on sidewalks ordinance amendment matter off 
the table.  The motion was approved by a voice vote.
President Logan made a request that was approved by a voice vote to have the Law Department, 
mayor and DPW Director attend next meeting to discuss. President Logan moved to table the 
matter. The motion was approved by a voice vote.
Councillor Hanley moved to adjourn. The motion was approved by a voice vote and Chairwoman 
Harris declared the meeting adjourned at 9:25 p.m.
Respectfully submitted,
Kara Wilson, Clerk of the Ordinances & Rules Committee
October 8, 2026
